# netactuate_nke_worker_nodes (Data Source)

Reads NKE Worker Nodes visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_nke_worker_nodes" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the NKE cluster

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `worker_nodes` (List of Object) List of worker nodes in the cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--worker_nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--worker_nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `worker_nodes`

Read-Only:

- `location_id` (Number)
- `location_name` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `package_id` (Number)
- `package_name` (String)
- `status_ready` (Boolean)
- `worker_node_id` (Number)
